card.name: Plural nouns before 'of' in study phrases
card.fires_on: The plural noun 'trials' or 'studies' after 'placebo-controlled clinical' or 'well-controlled', right before 'of' or a bracketed note. A few weaker cases are other nouns like 'conditions' or a store name.

modes.label: Study nouns
modes.description: The word 'trials' or 'studies' ends a phrase about controlled research.
modes.example: Pooled analyses of 199 placebo-controlled clinical<< trials>> (mono- and adjunctive therapy)

modes.label: Other nouns before 'of'
modes.description: A plural noun such as 'conditions' in a 'many of the ...' phrase.
modes.example: Self-treatment is not recommended for life-threatening conditions that require medical treatment under a doctor's care. For many of the<< conditions>> discussed, treatment with prescription or over the

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are 'sold', 'purchased' and 'services', so it mainly steers away from sales wording.
card.plain: It fires on the word 'trials' or 'studies' when a label describes the research behind a drug.
